title: LECAT: Measuring LLM Category Learning from Pretraining Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.18419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humans know that airplanes are fast, that this extends to red airplanes, but that it does not hold for broken airplanes. How do LLMs acquire category knowledge that humans learn and apply effortlessly? We introduce LeCat, a two-part framework to analyze LLM's Learning of Category knowledge. First, we use LeCat to evaluate models on their ability to learn category knowledge, distinguishing between three cases: memorization of in-domain category knowledge, generalization to unseen instances, and ability to flexibly use knowledge in appropriate contexts. Then, we use LeCat to trace how this knowledge can be learned in pretraining from text that may encode category knowledge in various ways, such as verbatim repetition or exceptions, which we refer to as forms of "knowledge expression". translated_title: LECAT：衡量大语言模型从预训练数据中的类别学习
translated_abstract: 人类知道飞机很快，这一属性也适用于红色的飞机，但不适用于损坏的飞机。大语言模型（LLM）是如何习得这些人类能够轻松学习和应用的类别知识的？我们提出了 LeCat，一个用于分析大语言模型类别知识学习的两阶段框架。首先，我们使用 LeCat 评估模型学习类别知识的能力，区分三种情况：对域内类别知识的记忆、对未见实例的泛化，以及在合适语境中灵活运用知识的能力。然后，我们使用 LeCat 追踪这些知识如何在预训练过程中从文本中习得——这些文本可能以各种方式编码类别知识，例如逐字重复或例外情况，我们将其称为不同的“知识表达”形式。我们首先使用 199 个精心整理的类别-特征对来评估开源预训练模型，并分析其训练数据。我们的发现表明，加强……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出 LeCat 两阶段框架，一方面评估大语言模型在记忆、泛化和灵活运用三个层面上的类别知识学习能力，另一方面通过追踪预训练文本中不同的“知识表达”形式来揭示这类知识在预训练中的习得机制。
en_tdlr: We introduce LeCat, a two-part framework that evaluates LLMs' category knowledge learning across memorization, generalization, and flexible use, and traces how different forms of "knowledge expression" in pretraining text enable the acquisition of such knowledge.
